Mobile Legends not working? Fix launch, connection and lag issues

Find the fix for your symptom, whether MLBB crashes at launch, gets stuck on the loading screen, shows a network error or lags in matches.

In this story

  1. What to check first
  2. Network errors, endless loading and regional access
  3. What to do if the app crashes on Android or iPhone
  4. How to tell high ping from low FPS
  5. What to send to MOONTON support
All news
In this story
What to check firstNetwork errors, endless loading and regional accessWhat to do if the app crashes on Android or iPhoneHow to tell high ping from low FPSWhat to send to MOONTON support

In brief

  • Stuck loading or seeing a network error? Close the game and retry on a different connection. Compare Wi‑Fi and mobile data on the same phone.
  • Crashing before the lobby? Restart your phone, check for updates and make sure you have space. On Android, start by clearing the cache.
  • Lobby works but matches lag? Compare ping and frame smoothness in Practice mode. Make sure you can sign back in before deleting the app or clearing its data.

What to check first

Match the symptom to the first check
SymptomFirst check
Closes immediately at launchRestart the phone. Open the game in your app store and check for an update.
Stuck on the splash screen or showing a network errorTry launching once on Wi‑Fi and once on mobile data.
Game opens but the account won’t sign inCheck which sign-in method you linked and record the exact error message.
Only matches lagCheck ping and frame smoothness in Practice mode.
Update download stallsIn the app store, check the connection and storage. If the download is inside the game, close it and try a different connection.

Network errors, endless loading and regional access

  1. Close MLBB fully. Check whether a normal website loads on the same connection. If that fails too, troubleshoot the connection itself first.
  2. Switch between Wi‑Fi and mobile data and reopen the game. Change only the connection for this comparison. If you already use a VPN, proxy or DNS filter, test its effect in a separate attempt.
  3. Compare the results. If MLBB works on only one connection, record which one fails. If both fail the same way, check for an update and see whether another player on a different network gets the same error.
  4. If you see a region availability warning, check whether it comes from your app store or from MLBB. Save the exact message. A store installation warning and a failure to connect to a match need different checks.

How to spot a wider outage

If several players on different devices and networks report the same error, check the game’s announcements. Reports can reveal a spike. Look for a MOONTON statement before attributing it to a specific cause.

Game announcements Mobile Legends news Check whether MOONTON has announced maintenance or an update. ↗

What to do if the app crashes on Android or iPhone

On Android, open system settings, find Mobile Legends in the app list and open its storage settings. Choose Clear cache. Menu labels vary by device. Clear data and Clear storage erase local app data, including settings and saved sign-in state. Save those for later, once you know you can sign back in.

On iPhone, close the game, restart the device and check the App Store for updates. If the store download stalls, check free space and Apple’s troubleshooting steps. Delete the app for a reinstall only after confirming access to the linked account.

App Store Apple’s download and update checks Official steps for iPhone and iPad. ↗ If sign-in is the issue Bind or recover your MLBB account Check your sign-in method before deleting the app.

How to tell high ping from low FPS

Signs of network lag and frame drops
In-match symptomWhat to try in Practice mode
Inputs arrive late, the hero jumps across the map or the game reconnectsCompare ping on both networks. Pause other downloads and updates.
The picture stutters, the phone heats up and ping stays stableLower graphics quality or the frame-rate setting by one step. Compare in a similar scene.
Problems only occur with a particular partyCompare solo and party play on the same device and connection. If it repeats, save the match ID.

If your version offers a network test in Settings, run it from the lobby. Repeat it on the same connection just before a match. Test any network-boost option separately and compare results. Depending on the mode, it may use mobile data.

What to send to MOONTON support

Use in-game support if you can open the lobby. If you cannot reach it, the publisher lists mobilelegendsgame@moonton.com. Include the time and time zone, exact error, phone model, game version and what happened on each connection. If it happened in a match, include the match ID. Leave out your password and verification codes.

Publisher contact Mobile Legends on the App Store Find the support address in the game listing. ↗

Frequently asked questions

Why do other sites work while MLBB gets stuck?

Sites and games connect to different servers. Try MLBB on a second connection to see whether the issue depends on the network.

Does clearing the cache delete my account?

On Android, clearing cache removes temporary files. Clearing app data or uninstalling resets local sign-in. Check your account link first, especially if you played as a guest.

Why is my ping high only in a party?

Compare solo and party play on the same phone and connection. If it repeats, send support the time and match ID. A single match rarely reveals the cause.
